prerequisites: Complete old/new projects, exact package pins, configuration, generated defaults and browser assets below. RC2 SDK 11.0.100-rc.2.26504.105; older SDK 10.0.402/runtime 10.0.13. Interpreted WASM needs no wasm-tools/AOT/native workload.

Use generated blazorwasm-servicedefaults library and its .lib.module.js; retain its assembly name/static asset path. OpenTelemetry packages 1.19.1 (exporter/hosting), 1.19.0 (HTTP/runtime instrumentation) are pinned below.

Aspire dependency when used: an actual compatible Aspire AppHost/integration must supply service references and Gateway/browser configuration. This manual loopback route uses no Aspire orchestrator, account, container or provisioning; it does not verify an Aspire route.
constraints: WASM; Components.Gateway, generated service-defaults library; Aspire dependency when used.

Gateway is a build/tool/manifest contract, not a normal lib API. Do not call framework-test-only BlazorGateway.BuildWebHost. StaticWebAssetSpaFallbackEnabled=true adds a nonfile index endpoint; API proxy routes must win, and backend 404 must remain 404.

ClientApps config is public. Browser logical quays resolves to the entry origin; Gateway logical quaybackend resolves to the real loopback backend. Never expose credentials or authoritative permissions.

This edition selects target 11 only. The compiled/executed .NET 10 ASP.NET Core host/YARP comparison remains valid; it does not claim older Gateway or generated-template support and adds no ninth .NET 10 foundation.

Local HTTP/development manifests only. HttpsRedirection and telemetry are disabled explicitly for loopback. Production TLS, authentication, path-base hosting, deployment, watch/debugger tooling, OTLP delivery, Aspire, trimming/AOT and GA need their own verification.
stabilityLimitations: RC2; GA pending. No Experimental attribute opt-in in this route.
